claims.basis: The actual compiled create_deep_agent graph ran through the ordinary worker. write_todos produced research-plan.v1 revisions (plan_updated events), and every event is labelled controlled. The compiled inventory probe passes 4/4.

No child exists before the canonical decision. The research_decision binds the exact review id and digest, and the approval it created is the one the dispatched child used (child plan_id equals the review id). The browser shows the exact review, keeps approve disabled until the exact checkbox is ticked, and dispatches exactly that plan. Forged, raw-command and actor-selection decisions are refused.
The approved child is an actual Counterdex job (certified_counterexample, verification valid, native artifact). An evidence_observed event references that evidence id.

Sessions differing only in the reviewed claim produce different next steps in the maintained plan. A certified counterexample yields a separately approved pair-design review step; no counterexample yields a step to review assumptions and the bounded search scope, with no pair design. These are controlled decisions over actual tool results, not live reasoning.

The no-counterexample report states that a bounded search finding no counterexample does not prove the claim, with no overclaiming wording. A session without design constraints proposes no design. A session without a reviewed problem creates no child and pauses at an honest research_clarification review.

The report snapshot keeps the exact question and binds the actual evidence ids, and the report download works. Native bytes match the recorded SHA-256 and size; the authenticated anchor binds the run; fresh replay with the matching source passes and keeps the outcome. The browser downloads (native, anchor, report) match the same records.

Replaying the same decision returns the same session with no new child. The same decision under a new key is refused (409), and so is a stale advance. Children, usage and revision are unchanged: one approved review produced one child.

Another identity gets 404 on the session, events, report, evidence and native artifact, through HTTP and through a second browser identity. No key, dummy marker or thread id appears in the visible research records. There are no external browser requests, and the private-session probes pass.

Using the ordinary in-process Worker, a ProviderFailure after the completed child (as the metered gateway reports one) leaves the session failed with provider_request_failed_unknown_outcome and publishes no report. The evidence, native bytes and replay are intact, with no physical call. An unhandled exception type is not covered: see F-RESEARCH-WORKER-UNGUARDED.

Controlled runs are labelled controlled everywhere (mode, events) and record zero physical calls and no Gemini attempt; the browser shows the local controlled policy. No live-labelled demonstration has been run: there is no coordinated live sample within the $0 allocation, and C makes no provider call. The live clause is therefore unqualified.
